name: airtable
description: Airtable integration — list, read, create, update, and delete records in an Airtable base via the REST API.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: Personal Access Token
fields.helpText: Create a scoped personal access token with data.records read/write access to your base.

fields.label: Base ID
fields.helpText: The base id, found in the API docs for your base (starts with 'app').

tools.name: airtable.list_records
tools.description: List records from a table, with optional formula filter, view, and paging controls.

table.description: Table name or table id (e.g. 'Tasks' or 'tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX')

filterByFormula.description: An Airtable formula to filter records, e.g. "{Status}='Done'"

maxRecords.description: Maximum total number of records to return

view.description: Name or id of a view; only records in that view are returned, in its order

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by a previous call to fetch the next page

tools.name: airtable.get_record
tools.description: Retrieve a single record by id from a table.

tools.name: airtable.create_record
tools.description: Create a new record in a table.

fields.description: Field name/value pairs for the new record, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Todo"}

tools.name: airtable.update_record
tools.description: Update fields on an existing record (a partial PATCH — only the given fields change).

fields.description: Field name/value pairs to set on the record

tools.name: airtable.delete_record
tools.description: Delete a record from a table. This is irreversible.
